newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lippo unit makes cash offer for Auric.
newsitem.headline: Lippo unit makes cash offer for Auric.

text.p: Overseas Union Bank Ltd said on Friday an associate of Indonesian conglomerate Lippo Group had made a cash offer of Singapore $2.42 each for the shares of Singapore food company Auric Pacific Group Ltd.
The bank said in a statement the Lippo associate, Jeremiah Holdings, would make an unconditional offer for all the shares in Auric not currently owned by it or its associates.
It said various associates of Lippo had agreed a series of deals to acquire Auric shares.
Auric said in February Lippo wanted to acquire 38.63 percent of the company by buying the stakes held by Pantagon Holdings Ltd and Nine Heritage.
